def analyze(row,col):
    x0=col*sq; y0=row*sq
    minx=999;maxx=-1;miny=999;maxy=-1
    colwidths=[]
    for yy in range(y0,y0+sq):

                if xx<minx:minx=xx

                if yy<miny:miny=yy

    width=maxx-minx+1
    # top profile: width at top, middle, bottom
